title: Nexera: Subsidiary Fort Technology Reports 49% Growth with Record $12 Million Year-to-Date Revenues, Advancing Toward Milestones for Additional Fort Shares
Fort Technology Reports Record Year-to-Date Revenues of $12 Million, Up 49%, and Record Year-to-Date Gross Profit of $2.1 Million
Fort Technology Enters into Credit Facility Agreements for Up to $20 Million to Support its Data Center and E-Commerce Activities
Fort Technology Announces Receipt of Approval for a Voluntary Delisting of its Common Shares From the TSX Venture Exchange
Fort Technology Announces Receipt of Nasdaq Notification Regarding Minimum Bid Price Requirement
